name: Soccer Team
label: Dischord
lede: Two Dischord employees started writing songs in a basement in Southeast DC, and nine years, one move to Flint and one husband on drums later, they had two albums on the label they worked for.

eras.title: Made in the basement
eras.text: Soccer Team started as two co-workers at Dischord trading songs in Ryan Nelson's house. Their first album was recorded start to finish on 4-track and 8-track in his basement, and Dischord put it out.

years.h: Two Dischord co-workers start Soccer Team
years.p: [[Ryan Nelson|758a01ba-b700-4b52-809a-917da0bb30e5]], of [[The Most Secret Method|9a6565fd-67d6-451f-8d1f-c006c9537193]] and [[Beauty Pill|976b28a1-dd68-4c43-ba08-ba15b58963b2]], and Melissa Quinley meet working at Dischord and start writing songs together at Nelson's house. Dischord dates Soccer Team to 2006.

Soccer Team's debut: fourteen songs recorded entirely in Ryan Nelson's basement studio in Southeast D.C. Nelson plays guitar, bass, keys and drums; Melissa Quinley plays keyboards and piano; both sing.
years.xp: Beauty Pill's [[Chad Clark|f3f09e99-e31c-4aa2-99e4-0b4e59e72f87]] mixed it at Silver Sonya, and T.J. Lipple mastered it there. Song titles run from Lobster Season to Johnny Hart's BC, a nod to the caveman comic strip, and Here's Why Dancers Smoke, which the band would come back to nine years later.

years.h: Live, Soccer Team are a trio with Justin Moyer on drums
years.p: Soccer Team is mostly a recording project, but when it plays out, [[Justin Moyer|68cb15fd-5c0c-4b60-ad06-935ac0756a4d]] of [[El Guapo|be23bf0a-67c6-4b2f-ba2a-89d983f5ebdd]] and [[Supersystem|b900616e-fd32-4c17-8f77-17ae2f1413a0]] sits behind the kit.

eras.title: Flint, and back
eras.text: Soccer Team went quiet when Ryan Nelson left D.C. for school in Flint, Michigan. A three-song single on Lovitt kept the name alive, and in 2012 he came home.

years.p: Soccer Team's three-song 7" for Lovitt, with a free download: Mental Anguish Is Your Friend, Letter To Saint Thomas Aquinas and World Series Apathy. Dischord distributes it.

years.h: Ryan Nelson returns to D.C.; Soccer Team is back
years.p: Soccer Team had been on hiatus while Ryan Nelson was in school in Flint, Michigan, according to Wikipedia. Back in Washington, he and Melissa Quinley pick the band up again.

eras.title: The four-piece and the second album
eras.text: For the first time Soccer Team became a real live band, with guitarist Jason Hutto and drummer Dennis Kane, Melissa Quinley's husband. It took nine years to follow up the first record, and two of the new album's songs were remakes of older ones.

years.h: Jason Hutto and Dennis Kane join Soccer Team's live band
years.p: Guitarist Jason Hutto, of [[The Aquarium|99200bf8-65e3-4073-93f6-fb81a4078d61]] and Warm Sun, and drummer Dennis Kane join Soccer Team's live line-up. Wikipedia notes Kane is Melissa Quinley's husband.

years.h: Soccer Team's Friends Who Know previews the second album
years.p: A summer single, the first taste of Soccer Team's second album, Real Lessons In Cynicism.

years.cap: Real Lessons In Cynicism, Dischord No. 182
years.p: Soccer Team's second album: fourteen songs, including new versions of Here's Why Dancers Smoke from the first album and Mental Anguish Is Your Friend from the Lovitt single. Brooklyn Vegan calls it high-quality, traditional-sounding indie rock.
years.xp:
Brooklyn Vegan premiered Too Many Lens Flares ahead of the October 27 release and billed Ryan Nelson and Melissa Quinley as the band's co-leaders. The same week, Nelson's other band [[Beauty Pill|976b28a1-dd68-4c43-ba08-ba15b58963b2]] was putting out its first album in eleven years.

Washington City Paper and Post-Trash reviewed it. Other titles carry the band's dry humor: Problems With Prolonged Youth, Dinner With Derelicts, Vacations On The Lam.

sources.title: Brooklyn Vegan: Soccer Team releasing Real Lessons In Cynicism
